<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user(1);
update_option('blogname','Jason Cortese — Elementor Portfolio');
update_option('elementor_disable_color_schemes','yes');
update_option('elementor_disable_typography_schemes','yes');
update_option('elementor_google_font','0');
update_option('elementor_onboarded',true);
delete_transient('elementor_activation_redirect');
$data=json_decode(base64_decode(''),true);
$images=[];
foreach(glob('/tmp/demo-*.jpg') as $source){
 $name=str_replace('demo-','',basename($source));$uploads=wp_upload_dir();$target=$uploads['path'].'/'.$name;copy($source,$target);
 $id=wp_insert_attachment(['post_title'=>pathinfo($name,PATHINFO_FILENAME),'post_status'=>'inherit','post_mime_type'=>'image/jpeg'],$target);
 update_attached_file($id,$target);$images[$name]=['id'=>$id,'url'=>$uploads['url'].'/'.$name];
}
function demo_map_images(&$elements,$images){foreach($elements as &$el){
 if(($el['widgetType']??'')==='image'){$name=basename($el['settings']['image']['url']);$el['settings']['image']=$images[$name];update_post_meta($images[$name]['id'],'_wp_attachment_image_alt',$el['settings']['_title']);}
 if(!empty($el['elements']))demo_map_images($el['elements'],$images);
}}
foreach($data as $slug=>$template){
 demo_map_images($template['content'],$images);
 $doc=\Elementor\Plugin::$instance->documents->create('wp-page',['post_title'=>$template['title'],'post_name'=>$slug,'post_status'=>'publish']);
 $doc->save(['elements'=>$template['content'],'settings'=>$template['page_settings']]);
 update_post_meta($doc->get_main_id(),'_wp_page_template','elementor_canvas');
}
\Elementor\Plugin::$instance->files_manager->clear_cache();
